# Adamastor

> Adamastor is a digital publication for all things startup in Portugal. We publish a weekly digest on the Portuguese startup scene and curate an events calendar for the tech and startup community.

## What we do

### Weekly Startup Digest

Original reporting and analysis on the Portuguese startup ecosystem — fundraises, launches, founder profiles, market commentary, and community news. Delivered to subscribers weekly and archived on the site.

### Events Calendar

Curated meetups, conferences, workshops, and founder gatherings across Portugal. Searchable by city and category. Each event links out to the original platform (Luma, Eventbrite, Meetup, etc.) for RSVP.

## Editorial team

- **Carlos Resende** — Co-founder and main author. Director of Founder Institute Portugal and curator of Techstars Startup Digest.
- **Afonso Gonçalves** — Co-founder. Chapter Director at Startup Grind Lisbon.
- **Malik Piara** — Co-founder. Also founder of LisboaUX (UX/design community in Lisbon), LisboaJS (JavaScript community in Lisbon), and Outono.org. Previously founded 351 Startup Community (no longer associated).

## Sibling properties

Adamastor coordinates with Malik's other Lisbon-area community properties when syndicating event content to audience-specific channels:

- **LisboaJS** — JavaScript / software-engineering community in Lisbon
- **LisboaUX** — UX / design community in Lisbon

## What we cover

- **Cities**: Lisboa, Porto, Online, Algarve, Aveiro, Braga, Coimbra, Guimarães, Leiria, Viseu
- **Event categories**: AI, Software Engineering, Design, Product Management, Startups & Fundraising

## Key URLs

### Editorial

- [Homepage / digest feed](https://adamastor.blog/)
- [About Adamastor](https://adamastor.blog/about)
- [RSS feed (weekly digest)](https://adamastor.blog/feed.xml)

### Events (browse by city)

- [All upcoming events](https://adamastor.blog/events)
- [Startup events in Lisboa](https://adamastor.blog/events/lisboa)
- [Startup events in Porto](https://adamastor.blog/events/porto)
- [Online startup events](https://adamastor.blog/events/online)

### Events (browse by category)

- [Design events](https://adamastor.blog/events/design)
- [Software Engineering events](https://adamastor.blog/events/software-engineering)
- [AI events](https://adamastor.blog/events/ai)
- [Product Management events](https://adamastor.blog/events/product)
- [Startup & Fundraising events](https://adamastor.blog/events/startups-fundraising)

### Combined (city + category)

URLs follow the pattern `/events/{city}/{category}`. Examples:

- [Design events in Lisboa](https://adamastor.blog/events/lisboa/design)
- [Software Engineering events in Porto](https://adamastor.blog/events/porto/software-engineering)
- [AI events in Lisboa](https://adamastor.blog/events/lisboa/ai)

### RSS feeds (events)

Every events route has a matching RSS feed at `<route>/feed.xml` — useful for syndicating Adamastor events into Slack channels, Telegram, embeds, newsletters, or any RSS-aware tool. Examples:

- [All events feed](https://adamastor.blog/events/feed.xml)
- [Lisboa events feed](https://adamastor.blog/events/lisboa/feed.xml)
- [Design events feed](https://adamastor.blog/events/design/feed.xml)
- [Design events in Lisboa feed](https://adamastor.blog/events/lisboa/design/feed.xml)

Outbound event links in these feeds are UTM-tagged so destination platforms (Luma, Eventbrite, Meetup) attribute traffic back to Adamastor with the specific feed that drove the click.

## Data freshness

The events listing is regenerated hourly. The weekly digest publishes once per week.
